senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; קָדַשׁ) [cut off, rejected, cmp. חרם] sodomite.
units: <cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 260:2">Sifré Deut. 260</cite> <he>ק׳ חמור</he> the sodomite whose crime is the severer one (v. infra).—Pl. <he>קְדֵשִׁים</he>.

Esth. R. to I, 9 (expl. מעולל, Is. III, 12) ק׳ בהון sodomites were among them (with ref. to ויתעללו, Jud. XIX, 25).—Fem. קְדֵשָׁה prostitute. Sifré l. c. ק׳ קלה the Ḳ’deshah whose crime is a minor one (compared with that of the Ḳadesh).
